clean_source_blocks.text: A pilot and ten skydivers died after a light aircraft crashed in Tomblaine, eastern France, on Sunday Eleven people have died after a civilian aircraft carrying skydivers crashed in the town of Tomblaine in eastern France, local authorities said. The pilot and 10 passengers died in the incident, including five students and five instructors, local officials said. The plane, which was being used by a parachutist school, had taken off from Nancy-Essey airfield when it crashed, local media reported. Police have urged the public to avoid the area around the airport in the Meurthe-et-Moselle department. This breaking news story is being updated and more details will be published shortly. Please refresh the page for the fullest version.

At least 11 people were killed after a small aircraft carrying skydivers crashed near Nancy in eastern France. Authorities have launched an investigation into the cause. Paris: A civilian aircraft carrying a group of skydivers crashed near Nancy in eastern France on Sunday, killing at least 11 people and triggering a major emergency response as authorities launched an investigation into the cause of the tragedy. A fatal plane crash near the French city of Nancy claimed the lives of at least 11 people on Sunday after a small civilian aircraft carrying skydivers went down in the town of Tomblaine. Emergency services rushed to the scene shortly after the crash, while police cordoned off the area and urged residents to stay away to allow rescue teams and investigators to work safely.
The pilot and 10 passengers died in the incident, local officials said.

According to French media reports, the aircraft was transporting a group of people preparing for a parachute jump when it crashed. Local officials confirmed that all 11 people on board were killed in the accident, making it one of France's deadliest aviation incidents involving a small civilian aircraft in recent years. Authorities warned that the crash site posed a potential explosion risk, prompting police to block access to nearby roads around Salvador Allende Street in Tomblaine. Residents were asked not to travel to the area as firefighters, emergency medical teams and investigators continued their operations. The cause of the crash has not yet been determined. Officials from the prosecutor's office, police and emergency medical service (SAMU) are expected to provide further information as the investigation progresses.

At least 11 people were killed after a small aircraft carrying skydivers crashed near Nancy in eastern France. Authorities have launched an investigation into the cause.

Paris: A civilian aircraft carrying a group of skydivers crashed near Nancy in eastern France on Sunday, killing at least 11 people and triggering a major emergency response as authorities launched an investigation into the cause of the tragedy.

A fatal plane crash near the French city of Nancy claimed the lives of at least 11 people on Sunday after a small civilian aircraft carrying skydivers went down in the town of Tomblaine. Emergency services rushed to the scene shortly after the crash, while police cordoned off the area and urged residents to stay away to allow rescue teams and investigators to work safely.

According to French media reports, the aircraft was transporting a group of people preparing for a parachute jump when it crashed.

Local officials confirmed that all 11 people on board were killed in the accident, making it one of France's deadliest aviation incidents involving a small civilian aircraft in recent years.

Authorities warned that the crash site posed a potential explosion risk, prompting police to block access to nearby roads around Salvador Allende Street in Tomblaine.

Residents were asked not to travel to the area as firefighters, emergency medical teams and investigators continued their operations.

The cause of the crash has not yet been determined. Officials from the prosecutor's office, police and emergency medical service (SAMU) are expected to provide further information as the investigation progresses.

Investigators will examine the aircraft's condition, weather, flight path and other possible factors to determine what caused the fatal crash.

Authorities have not yet released the identities of the victims or confirmed additional details about the aircraft. The investigation remains ongoing, with more official information expected in the coming hours.

payload.title: Laskuvarjohyppääjiä kuljettanut pienkone putosi Ranskassa, 11 kuoli
payload.summary: Pienkone putosi Tomblainessa Itä-Ranskassa sunnuntaina. Paikallisten viranomaisten mukaan kaikki koneessa olleet 11 ihmistä, lentäjä ja kymmenen matkustajaa, kuolivat.
payload.content:
Laskuvarjohyppääjiä kuljettanut siviilikäytössä ollut pienkone putosi sunnuntaina Tomblainessa Itä-Ranskassa lähellä Nancya. Paikallisten viranomaisten mukaan onnettomuudessa kuolivat kaikki koneessa olleet 11 ihmistä: lentäjä ja kymmenen matkustajaa, joista viisi oli oppilaita ja viisi kouluttajia.

## Kone oli noussut Nancy-Esseyn lentokentältä

Kone oli paikallisten mediatietojen mukaan laskuvarjohyppykoulun käytössä. Se oli noussut Nancy-Esseyn lentokentältä ennen putoamistaan Tomblaineen, joka sijaitsee Meurthe-et-Mosellen departementissa Nancyn lähistöllä.

Lähdetietojen mukaan kone kuljetti ryhmää, joka oli matkalla laskuvarjohyppyyn tai valmistautumassa siihen. Viranomaiset eivät ole kertoneet julkisuuteen tarkkaa putoamishetkeä, lentoreittiä tai sitä, missä vaiheessa lentoa turmakone oli onnettomuuden tapahtuessa.

## Pelastustoimet ja alueen eristäminen

Pelastusviranomaiset hälytettiin paikalle pian turman jälkeen. Alue eristettiin, jotta palokunta, ensihoito ja tutkijat pystyivät työskentelemään turvallisesti. Poliisi kehotti yleisöä välttämään lentokentän ympäristöä ja turmapaikan lähialuetta.

Paikallisten tietojen mukaan viranomaiset sulkivat pääsyn myös Salvador Allende -kadun lähistölle Tomblainessa. Turmapaikalla varoitettiin mahdollisesta räjähdysriskistä, minkä vuoksi asukkaita pyydettiin pysymään poissa alueelta ja välttämään lähiteillä liikkumista.

## Onnettomuuden syytä tutkitaan

Onnettomuuden syytä ei ole vielä selvitetty. Viranomaiset ovat käynnistäneet tutkinnan, ja lisätietoja odotetaan syyttäjänvirastolta, poliisilta ja ensihoitopalvelu SAMUlta tutkinnan edetessä.

Turmaa on kuvattu yhdeksi Ranskan vakavimmista viime vuosien pienkoneonnettomuuksista. Viranomaiset eivät ole toistaiseksi julkaisseet uhrien nimiä. Tapaus on edelleen alkuvaiheen tutkinnassa, ja tarkemmat tiedot tapahtumien kulusta varmistuvat vasta myöhemmin.
summary_bullets: Kaikki koneessa olleet 11 ihmistä kuolivat, viranomaiset kertovat.
Kone oli laskuvarjohyppykoulun käytössä ja oli noussut Nancy-Esseyn lentokentältä.
Onnettomuuden syytä tutkitaan, ja poliisi on eristänyt aluetta.
